description: Assemble a small explorer robot: two DC motors with wheels on a chassis, a servo that pans a front ultrasonic sensor, and the controller board with its wiring. The battery is connected only after all wiring is done, then the robot is switched on.

steps.instruction_es: Primero monta los dos motores amarillos en sus soportes, con el eje hacia afuera.
steps.completion_cue: Both yellow gear motors sit against their brackets on the chassis with shafts pointing outward.

steps.instruction_es: Ahora encaja una rueda en cada eje de motor hasta que quede a ras.
steps.completion_cue: A rubber wheel is pushed fully onto each motor shaft, flush with no gap.

steps.instruction_es: Inserta el servo azul en su soporte, con el eje hacia arriba.
steps.completion_cue: The blue servo sits in its bracket at the front with the output shaft facing up.

steps.instruction_es: Coloca el sensor ultrasónico en su soporte sobre el servo, con los ojos hacia adelante.
steps.completion_cue: The ultrasonic sensor is held in its mount on the servo with both round transducers facing forward.

steps.instruction_es: Atornilla la placa controladora sobre el chasis.
steps.completion_cue: The blue controller board is laid on the chassis spacers and screwed down.

steps.instruction_es: Conecta los cables de los motores a los bornes del driver y apriétalos.
steps.completion_cue: Each motor's two wires are clamped in the motor driver's screw terminals.

steps.instruction_es: Conecta el cable del servo a la placa, con el cable café en GND.
steps.completion_cue: The servo's 3-pin connector is on the board pins with the brown wire on the GND pin.

steps.instruction_es: Conecta los cuatro cables del sensor a la placa.
steps.completion_cue: Four jumper wires run from the sensor's pins to the controller board header.

steps.instruction_es: Con todo el cableado listo, conecta los cables de la batería al interruptor.
steps.completion_cue: The battery pack's red and black leads are connected to the switch/power terminals.

steps.instruction_es: Por último, enciende el interruptor y revisa que se prenda el LED.
steps.completion_cue: The power switch is flipped on and an LED on the board lights up.

mistakes.description: The battery is connected before the motor, servo and sensor wiring is finished.
mistakes.visual_cue: Battery leads are attached to the switch while some motor, servo or sensor wires are still unconnected.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, desconecta la batería y termina todo el cableado antes de conectarla.

mistakes.description: The servo is inserted into its bracket upside down, with the shaft pointing down.
mistakes.visual_cue: The servo's output shaft points down or into the chassis instead of up.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, saca el servo y vuelve a ponerlo con el eje hacia arriba.

mistakes.description: The servo connector is plugged in reversed, with the orange signal wire on GND.
mistakes.visual_cue: The orange wire of the servo connector sits on the GND side of the pins instead of the brown wire.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, da vuelta el conector del servo para que el cable café quede en GND.

mistakes.description: A wheel is only partly pushed onto the motor shaft and wobbles.
mistakes.visual_cue: A visible gap between the wheel hub and the motor, or the wheel sits tilted on the shaft.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, empuja la rueda hasta el fondo para que quede a ras del motor.
